tmp:2247: charon af — 'fierce anger'/burning wrath, the divine (and human) attribute of anger that must be sweetened, imaged as smoke rising from the nostrils (Ps. 18:9)
tmp:2248: the smoke issuing from His nostrils (Ps. 18:9 'smoke went up in His nose') — the bodily/anthropomorphic image of charon af, divine burning anger
tmp:2249: asarah minei zimrah — the ten kinds of song/melody, corresponding to the ten expressions of Psalms, whose power nullifies the kelipah (basis of the Tikkun HaKlali's ten psalms)
tmp:2250: the ten expressions (leshonot) with which the Book of Psalms was composed — Ashrei, Lamnatzeach, Maskil, Halleluyah, etc. (Pesachim 117a; Zohar)
tmp:2251: asarah minei nigguna — the ten types of melody symbolized by the letter Yud (numerical value 10) within the Hei, linked to the future song (simple-double-triple-quadruple)
tmp:2252: ishah ra'ah — the 'evil woman/wife,' a kelipah-figure identified with the 'evil time' (et ra'ah), counterpart to the evil maidservant opposing the Shekhinah
tmp:2254: shifchah bisha — the 'evil maidservant' (Aramaic), the kelipah that usurps the Shekhinah/Malkhut, identified with the 'evil time' (et ra'ah)
tmp:2255: sippurei ma'asiyot shel shanim kadmoniyot — telling stories/tales of ancient years, an activity that is the aspect of Atik (the most ancient partzuf), signified by the carob/elder
tmp:2257: 'the one seated upon the throne' — the enthroned figure of the Chariot vision identified as Atik Yomin (Daniel 7:9 'and the Ancient of Days sat')
tmp:2258: Atik Yomin — the 'Ancient of Days' (Dan. 7:9), the highest partzuf of Keter, here the one who sits upon the throne above the four chayot
tmp:2259: shefer — 'beauty/fine' (from 'imrei shafer,' Gen. 49:21), wordplay-cognate of pe'er (glory), the aspect of tefillin and the illumination of Jacob's face
tmp:2261: pegam ha-begadim — the blemish/stain of the garments (the stain on one's clothing), external sign of blemishing the totality of the gidin (sinews), tied to pegam ha-brit
tmp:2263: mitmasken — 'becoming impoverished,' the state of falling into poverty as punishment for blemishing Chokhmah by building a house without wisdom ('the poor man's wisdom is despised,' Eccl. 9:16)
tmp:2264: eating like a glutton and drunkard (zolel ve-sovei) — coarse, unrestrained eating that blemishes the altar (mizbeach) of holy eating and feeds the kelipot
tmp:2265: pegam ha-raglin — the blemish of the legs/feet, the state of unrectified sparks before elevation into holy speech, imaged as Jacob 'limping on his thigh' (Gen. 32:32)
tmp:2266: chatzot — midnight, the practice/time of rising at halakhic midnight (six hours into the night) for lament and thanksgiving, propitious like a pidyon for sweetening judgments (Ps. 119:62)
tmp:2267: pidyon — a redemption(-payment) that sweetens the dinim (harsh judgments); midnight is likened to it in efficacy
tmp:2268: striking palm against palm — clapping the hands in prayer, whose 5×5+5×5=50 strikings of the finger-lights form the mouth (the Fifty Gates), a theurgic act
tmp:2271: giving charity in secret (matan ba-seter) — the concealed act of tzedakah that 'subdues anger' (Prov. 21:14), tied to the six pei-sounds of the alphabet
tmp:2272: expelling the bad bloods — the salutary action of salt (the tzaddik as 'covenant of salt') purging the turbid blood that breeds sadness and lusts
tmp:2273: mishpetei ha-Torah — the civil/legal judgments (laws) of the Torah, embodied in the poskim, by which 'a king establishes the land' and sunken gates are revealed
tmp:2274: poskim — the halakhic decisors/legal authorities, embodiment of the Torah's mishpatim through which the land's sunken gates are revealed
tmp:2275: chittukh ha-yadayim — the 'cutting/articulation of the hands' (chatakh), the apportioning action hinted in the acrostic of 'Pote'ach et yadekha,' governing sustenance
tmp:2276: 'Pote'ach et yadekha' — the verse 'You open Your hand' (Ps. 145:16), whose final letters spell ChaTaKh, the divine name of parnassah/apportionment
tmp:2277: Pachad Yitzchak — 'the Fear of Isaac' (Gen. 31:42), the sefirah Gevurah personified in Isaac, holy judgment born from Abraham's Chesed
tmp:2278: Pishon — the first river of Eden, homiletically read as 'pi shoneh (halakhot),' the mouth that repeats halakhot
tmp:2279: pi shoneh halakhot — 'the mouth that studies/repeats halakhot,' the act of reciting Jewish law, derived from the name Pishon
tmp:2283: penei rabbo — 'the face of one's master,' whose greeting on the festival means receiving the festival's great light, since Yom Tov's holiness depends on the tzaddikim
tmp:2289: shoresh ha-emunah — the root of faith: the higher 'world of faith' from which emunah is drawn, which itself has faith in God; faith's inner source
tmp:2291: penimiyut ha-nefesh — the inner dimension of the soul (nefesh), equated with inner faith, since nefesh and emunah are one (Isa. 26:9 with Ps. 92:3, both 'in the night')
tmp:2292: torot acherot — 'other torahs,' false teachings emanating from the Sitra Achra via unholy brazenness, the counterfeit opposite of holy Torah
tmp:2293: pesilim — 'idols/carved images,' the name for Sitra Achra's counterfeit torah held by the brazen-faced, inverse of 'pesal lekha' (carve for yourself) of holy Torah
tmp:2295: 'his steps become shortened' — the shortening of a man's strides when his first wife dies (Sanhedrin 22a), applied to one who desecrates Shabbat (his 'first wife')
tmp:2296: kafui ve-kal — 'floating and light,' the trait of a prayer/substance that rises to the top like scum, marking it as refuse (pesolet) versus worthy prayer
tmp:2297: pesolet — refuse/dross, the waste element (light and floating) separated out from prayers/food, as opposed to the worthy essence
tmp:2299: thinking good thoughts — revealing one's good middot within the heart's cleared empty space (chalal panui) after contracting its blaze, mirroring the cosmic void of creation
tmp:2301: chokhmah she-ba-lev — the wisdom in the heart, the good attributes/secret of world-creation revealed within the heart's empty void after tzimtzum of its fiery ardor
tmp:2302: awakening people from their sleep — the tzaddik's act of rousing those who 'sleep away their days' in dormant spiritual service, which effects pekidat akarot (remembering barren women)
tmp:2303: sustaining one's Father in Heaven through prayer — Israel 'feeding' God via tefillah, in proportion to which one's own parnassah is granted through the twelve tribal prayer-paths
tmp:2305: Tikkun HaKlali as tikkun ha-brit — the general rectification, i.e., rectifying the covenant (sexual purity), the 'way of the eagle in the heavens' that yields effortless livelihood (bread from heaven/manna)
